card.desc: Rain heard from inside - shed, car, attic, shelter.
card.prompt: heavy rain falling on a corrugated metal roof, thousands of individual drops striking sheet metal, continuous, close underneath, water running off an edge
card.note: Name the SURFACE or you get generic hiss - the surface is the whole sound. Metal, canvas, leaves, car roof and window glass are five different beds, so re-run with the noun swapped rather than trying to EQ one into another. Keep thunder out of this bed and run thunder_distant separately; it cannot layer, and mixed in you lose the ability to time the strike.

evidence.method: nothing has checked this card against pixels
